home.title: Online Survey
home.message:
Dear colleagues:
As part of the preparation for a PhD thesis entitled: "The role of internal control in activating corporate governance in public economic institutions in the transport sector - a case study of public institutions for urban and semi-urban transport (ETUS)", we present to you this questionnaire, which is one of the tools used to collect primary data in academic scientific research. We kindly ask you to answer all the questions in the questionnaire axes accurately and objectively, knowing that your answers are used only for scientific research purposes.
Researcher
CHORFI Bilel

thank_you_message: We sincerely thank you for your valuable time and effort in completing this questionnaire.

questions.q1: The general management of ETUS adheres to integrity and ethical values, and establishes them as a fundamental part of the corporate culture.
questions.q2: The board of directors or supervisory body of ETUS exercises independent and effective oversight over the development and implementation of the internal control system.
questions.q3: ETUS management defines the organizational structure, lines of authority and responsibility, and necessary reporting to enable effective execution of control tasks.
questions.q4: ETUS management demonstrates commitment to recruiting, developing and retaining competent employees, including providing ongoing training.
questions.q5: ETUS holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities, consistent with defined objectives.
